CONDITIONAL: QA1 gate-1 audit, sprint 2, round 1. VERDICT: CONDITIONAL (one requirement not met, rest are good).
Audited: HEAD 3c00022 (code in 5ca5c50; 3c00022 is start-bookkeeping only). Working tree clean. Sprint file re-read fresh; its only change since creation is the status frontmatter line. No criterion of the between-two-versions kind, so the sprint-9 check does not apply.
Checks run: npm test 257 pass / 8 skipped; npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint clean. The 8 skipped DB tests were run against the running local stack with its local keys: 14/14 pass (uniqueness 23505, forced profile-failure rollback plus same-email retry, emailTaken, RLS read/update/column refusals).

REQUIRED FIX (blocking):
1. Req 16 / AC17 not met: the no-literal-colour check still scans only app and lib. tests/no-literal-colors.test.ts line 14 is SCAN_DIRS = [app, lib], unchanged in this commit. Demonstrated: npx vitest run tests/no-literal-colors.test.ts --reporter verbose lists every scanned file, and none of the 7 tracked files under components/ (AvatarPicker, TabBar, ui/Button, ui/LinkButton, ui/PasswordInput, ui/TextInput, ui/button-style) appears, nor proxy.ts at the repo root. The requirement names components/ explicitly. A colour literal added to components/TabBar.tsx today would pass CI. (git grep shows no literal there right now, so this is a missing guard, not a live leak.) Fix: scan every application source directory (components/ and root-level .ts like proxy.ts included), ideally by walking the repo minus node_modules, .next, tests, public, docs and supabase, so the next new directory is covered automatically. Apply the same list to the arena-scan block in tests/arenas.test.ts (line 74 has the same app+lib gap). My own manual AC13 grep over components/ and proxy.ts found no threshold or arena name, so AC13 itself is met.

SHOULD FIX (non-blocking, fix now while in there):
2. Landing layout vs copy doc: screen-copy.md Landing table says the tagline Earn trophies / Climb arenas sits ABOVE the logo, but app/page.tsx renders the Image first and the tagline after it. The table also lists a Host caption, which suggests a host image on frame 1.00 that the page lacks. Check against frame 1.00 before LiveQA fails it on AC1.
3. Display-name length mismatch between JS and the DB: validation uses String.length (UTF-16 units), but the DB check uses char_length (code points). node shows a single emoji has .length 2 and 1 code point. That name passes the shared module, then the insert fails with check_violation 23514, the auth user is rolled back, and the player sees the generic fallback instead of Need at least 2 characters. Six emoji (12 units, 6 code points) is wrongly rejected as too long. Count code points in the module so browser, server and DB agree.
4. SignupForm: server fieldErrors take precedence over live client errors and are never cleared until the next submit, so a taken display name keeps its taken message after the player edits it. Clear a server error when its field changes.
5. signupAction has no try/catch around createAccount or the post-create signInWithPassword. supabase-js usually returns errors rather than throwing, but createAdminClient throws on missing env and a thrown fetch would reach the error boundary with no fallback message (NFR-7). loginAction already handles this; do the same here.
6. ProfilePage on a profile-load failure (e.g. an orphaned credential after a failed rollback) redirects to /login, which proxy bounces to /home. It does not loop, but the player gets no message. Acceptable for this sprint because it is logged; noting it.

VERIFIED MET: Req 1 (proxy redirects, tested); 2 (picker matches design-tokens spec: 68x68, snap x mandatory and center, 15px gap, 45px padding, 2.5px accent ring via token, accessible name Choose your avatar. with the full stop, ten ids matching public/avatars); 3 (one module lib/validation/signup.ts imported by the form and re-run server-side in createAccount, messages verbatim, reserved list matches the Starter opponents section exactly, AC3 unit cases all present); 4 (unique index on lower(display_name), DB test, 23505 mapped to taken); 5 (controlled local state, tested); 6 (read line by line: only the rollback-delete-failure path and a process crash between createUser and insert can orphan a credential. The first is logged loudly, the second is inherent to two systems. Forced-failure test passes live); 7 (admin createUser with email_confirm true, no email API anywhere); 8 (RLS select/update own, column-level update grant on exactly three columns, revoke all, no insert/delete; runtime tests pass); 9 (credentials vs generic mapping, tested; Forgot Password omitted as allowed); 10 (proxy.ts per Next 16, getUser not getSession, next param never read, every page re-checks getVerifiedUser, no handler takes a user id from body or query); 11 (tab bar with aria-current, home copy verbatim, arena label from getArenaForTrophies, play and leaderboard empty shells, tutorial redirects); 12 (UTC MMM D, YYYY tested; native dialog; signOut via cookie client); 13 (single ARENAS, thresholds and labels correct, boundary tests incl. 0/199/200/599/600/2999/3000/100000, six backgrounds as CSS vars in tokens.css); 14 (44px/8px inputs, 52px/10px buttons via radius tokens, accent focus border, type-error in color-error-text below the field, aria-describedby association, focus-visible outline); 15 (errors logged, no swallowed catch in app code); 17 health route uses the no-session anon client, grant unchanged, test asserts cookies never read and 200 ok.

Re-audit scope once fixed: the scan-path change plus whichever of items 2 to 5 Dev Team takes; the rest of the diff will not need a full re-read unless it moves.

PASS: QA1 gate-1 audit, sprint 2, round 2 (re-audit). VERDICT: PASS.
Audited: HEAD db2b0c7 (fix commit on top of 3aac97d). Working tree clean. Sprint file re-read fresh: no diff since 3c00022, so requirements are unchanged from round 1; re-audit scoped to the fix commit (11 files). No criterion of the between-two-versions kind.
Checks run: npm test 285 pass / 8 skipped (DB tests; db2b0c7 touches no migration, create-account.ts or DB code, so round 1 live DB results stand); npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint clean.

ROUND 1 REQUIRED FIX, now MET:
1. Req 16 / AC17: tests/support/scan-source-files.ts walks the repo root with an exclusion list (node_modules, dot-dirs, tests, public, docs, supabase, scripts, templates) instead of an app+lib allow-list. Demonstrated with npx vitest run tests/no-literal-colors.test.ts tests/arenas.test.ts --reporter verbose: all 7 components/ files and proxy.ts now appear as scanned files in BOTH the colour-literal check and the arena threshold/name checks, plus next.config.ts and vitest.config.ts. A new source directory is covered automatically.

ROUND 1 SHOULD-FIX ITEMS:
2. Landing: tagline now renders above the logo, with a document-order test. The Host caption string is present verbatim. Whether frame 1.00 also carries a host image is a visual check for LiveQA on AC1, not decidable from the copy doc.
3. Display-name length now counts code points via Array.from, matching Postgres char_length. Tests cover 2, 6 and 11 emoji.
4. SignupForm: server field errors clear once their field is edited, reset on each new response using the documented adjust-state-during-render pattern. Test added.
5. signupAction: wrapped in try/catch with generic fallback and console.error. redirect() is correctly kept outside the try, so NEXT_REDIRECT is not swallowed. Five action tests cover success, sign-in failure to /login, field errors, createAccount throwing, and createClient throwing.
6. Profile-load failure with no message: unchanged, accepted in round 1 as logged.

No new issues found. Everything verified met in round 1 stands: requirements 1-15 and 17 as recorded there, and 16 now fully met.

FAIL: LiveQA round 1, sprint 2 (Accounts and session). Verdict FAIL. Tested 2026-09-13 20:53 UTC to 2026-09-14 15:26 UTC against https://show-off-test.vercel.app. Deployed commit a33b52e.
Vercel get_deployment: id dpl_J2Y1MAnHPUamiU81tuMSZQ9ydkJF, target production, READY, githubCommitSha d5502e7cc6869e096477351d474f33e64dafd1d2 (ship record, child of a33b52e). git diff --stat a33b52e d5502e7 shows only docs/sprints/state/sprint-2.json. CI success: run 34774043631 (a33b52e) and 34774186359 (d5502e7).
Tools: Claude in Chrome (macOS, desktop window plus same-origin iframes at 320, 375 and 500 wide), Figma in the browser (view only), curl, Supabase MCP (read-only SELECT), Vercel MCP (runtime logs and deployment, read-only), GitHub REST API.
Operator did every step that needed a password or account creation. LiveQA does not create accounts or enter passwords; it observed and measured each result in the same browser.
Per operator instruction, every criterion ran before this verdict was recorded.

DEFECTS
1. [Required; AC2, AC14] Sign-up avatar picker overflows the page on phone widths.
   /signup at 320 wide: document scrollWidth 612 (horizontal scroll).
   The radiogroup "Choose your avatar." (class no-scrollbar flex overflow-x-auto, scroll-snap x mandatory) is 905px wide, and its scrollWidth equals its clientWidth, so it never scrolls itself. It grows and is centred in the 272px form, starting at x -292.
   Avatar left edges at 320: -247, -164, -81, 2, 85, 168, 251, 334, 417, 500. Avatars 1-3 sit left of x 0, where neither page nor element scrolling can reach them.
   Keyboard: Tab focuses Avatar 1 at x -247 with a visible 2px accent outline, but it stays off-screen. Tabbing to Avatar 10 scrolls the whole page right, pushing the form off the left edge.
   The label "Choose your avatar" (p#avatar-picker-label) box is x -292, width 905, left-aligned, so its text is off-screen at 320.
   Other widths: 375 docSW 640, 3 avatars off the left edge; 500 docSW 702, 2 off; 1280 no overflow.
2. [Required; AC3] The "no avatar" message never appears. Submitted at 320 by real keystrokes: display name Mojito123456, email mojojojo\, password M, no avatar. The page showed exactly three messages: "Exceeds 10 character limit.", "Invalid email address.", "Need at least 8 characters.". "Please choose an avatar." is nowhere in the DOM (innerText searched).
3. [Required; AC9, AC15] Network-offline login shows a crash page, not the fallback message, and throws an unhandled exception.
   Operator set DevTools Network to Offline (navigator.onLine false) and submitted /login.
   Result: the whole page was replaced by the white fallback error page "This page couldn’t load" / "Reload to try again, or go back." with Reload and Back buttons. Expected: "Something went wrong. Try again." on the form.
   Console: [EXCEPTION] 8:25:57 AM local, TypeError: Failed to fetch at _next/static/immutable/chunks/2-cv0o8myd3_a.js:1:34009, unhandled.
4. [Required; AC1] Landing / does not match Figma frame 1.00 (QA1's open host-image question).
   Frame 1.00 (Game UI page, 375x667, fill #251F1F) shows a large host illustration (presenter in green jacket with microphone) behind an oversized SHOW OFF logo, with the caption "Think you know stuff? Let's find out." on a dark label over the host. The tagline is grey uppercase and rotated. The host sits above a black lower panel holding the button and log-in prompt.
   Production / renders only: tagline "Earn trophies ★ Climb arenas" (mixed case, white, text-transform none), the logo image (197x174 at 375), the caption as plain grey text, the button and the prompt. document.images contains only /brand/show-off-logo.svg; no host image.
   Strings and links do pass: text is exactly "Earn trophies", "★", "Climb arenas", "Think you know stuff? Let's find out.", "Get started" (href /signup), "Already have an account? Log in" (href /login). No Terms or v1.0 text.
5. [Required; AC11] /home does not match Figma frame 3.00.
   Frame 3.00 (375x667, radial gradient #1D4D49 to #082530) has:
   - heading at top, in two lines;
   - a dark card containing the arena label (teal), a trophy icon, the body text, a "Let’s play" button and "See how it works" as a text link;
   - host image cropped as a circular head-and-shoulders portrait at bottom left, with "Fresh meat. I like it." and "Welcome to the Arena." as two dark speech tags beside it;
   - tab bar as a rounded pill with Home, Leaderboard and Profile icons over labels.
   Production /home at desktop:
   - plain black background;
   - full-body host image (via next/image, url /host/host-01-neutral.png, w 384) at the top, 160x196, not cropped to a circle;
   - host lines as centred plain text below it, then arena label, heading, body;
   - "Let’s play" filled button and "See how it works" outlined button;
   - no card, no trophy icon, no gradient;
   - text-only tab bar with no icons.
   Copy is verbatim (see passes).
6. [Medium; AC12 visual against 8.14] The log-out confirmation dialog is pinned to the top-left and styled unlike 8.14.
   Production: dialog element, :modal true, focus moves inside it (good), but margin 0 and inset 0. Box at (0,0) 320x266 on desktop, (0,0) 288x266 at 320, (0,0) 320x266 at 375. ::backdrop rgba(0,0,0,0.1). "Log out" is a filled accent-green button, "Cancel" an outlined button (both 52px, 10px radius).
   Frame 8.14: dialog centred over a heavily dimmed profile, "Log out" button in the red error colour, "Cancel" as a plain text link.
   Copy is verbatim: "Leaving already?", "Your trophies will be here when you get back.", "Log out", "Cancel".

PASSES
- AC1 signed in: /, /signup and /login each landed on /home. /tutorial also went to /home.
- AC5: after a failed submit, displayName Mojito123456, email mojojojo\ and password M stay filled. After selecting Avatar 5 and failing again, avatar-5 stays selected (aria-checked true, hidden input avatar-5).
- AC2 ring: the selected avatar shows box-shadow rgb(180, 255, 0) 0 0 0 2.5px. 10 avatars, each 68x68, role radio, labelled "Avatar 1" to "Avatar 10".
- AC3 partial: the three messages shown are verbatim; each input is aria-invalid true, aria-describedby points to its message (role alert), and the message renders below the field in 11px Space Grotesk rgb(253, 189, 190). Invalid input border rgb(255, 100, 103). Nothing was sent to the server (validation ran in the browser).
- AC7: operator created chris@example.com and landed straight on /home. Supabase: confirmation_sent_at null, email_confirmed_at 04:39:57.463 (immediately after creation at 04:39:57.418), no confirmation email.
- AC9: wrong password for chris@example.com shows exactly "Incorrect email or password." (role alert, type-error styling); operator screenshot shows the same. Unregistered nobody-01@example.com shows exactly "Incorrect email or password." No console output in either case.
- AC10:
  - Signed out, all five routes redirect (curl: /home, /play, /profile, /leaderboard, /tutorial each 307 to /login).
  - Reload keeps the session (reload on /home stays /home; reload after Cancel stays /profile).
  - Operator logged in at /login?next=https://example.com by keyboard (Tab and Enter) and landed on show-off-test.vercel.app/home, with no request to example.com.
- AC11 partial:
  - Tab bar on /home, /play, /leaderboard, /profile. aria-current page on Home (/home), Leaderboard (/leaderboard) and Profile (/profile); /play marks none, since Play is not a tab.
  - /home copy verbatim: "Fresh meat. I like it.", "Welcome to the Arena.", "Arena 1 · Warm Up", "YOUR KNOWLEDGE + YOUR SPEED = YOUR TROPHIES", "10 questions. 1 opponent. The faster you answer correctly, the more you score. Climb the arenas...if you can.", "Let’s play", "See how it works".
  - "Let’s play" goes to /play; "See how it works" goes via /tutorial back to /home.
  - /play and /leaderboard innerText is only Home, Leaderboard, Profile.
- AC12: /profile shows avatar-5.svg (96px), "chris" (uppercased by CSS) and "Showing off since Sep 14, 2026", which matches the profile created_at 2026-09-14 04:39:57 UTC in MMM D, YYYY format.
  Log out then Cancel closes the dialog, and reload stays on /profile.
  Log out then confirm lands on /; reload stays /; /profile and /home then redirect to /login.
- AC14 partial:
  - Keyboard: Tab order on /signup runs avatars 1-10, display name, email, password, Show password, Create account, Sign in. Focus is visible: 2px accent outline on avatars and Show, accent border rgb(180, 255, 0) on inputs.
  - Operator's keyboard-only login (Tab and Enter) worked. Sign-up keyboard-only was not observed (operator created the account before this was asked).
  - Inputs 44px with 8px radius, buttons 52px with 10px radius on /signup and /login.
  - No horizontal scroll at 320 or 375 on /, /login, /home, /play, /leaderboard, /profile. The one failure is /signup, see defect 1.
  - Screen-reader association was checked structurally (aria-describedby plus role alert); no screen reader was run.
- AC15: no console messages through landing, sign-up validation, signed-in navigation, profile, log out, wrong-password and unregistered-email flows. The only exception was the offline case (defect 3).
- AC17 / D-62: signed in (auth cookie present), fetch /api/health returned 200 {"ok":true,"database":true}. Signed out also 200 (curl).
- Login page copy: "WELCOME BACK", "Sign in to pick up where you left off." (in the copy inventory, line 425), placeholders "Email" and "Password (min 8 characters)", "Log in", "Don’t have an account? Sign up" (href /signup). Forgot Password is omitted, which is allowed.
- No regressions: 15:26 UTC /api/health 200; mailer_autoconfirm true.

UNCONFIRMED OBSERVATION (not a defect)
The extension's network log showed status 503 for some Next.js router fetches: /home?_rsc (4 of 4 clicks on "See how it works"), a /play?_rsc prefetch, and POST /login during the unregistered-email attempt. The same routes fetched directly from the page returned 200. Vercel production runtime logs showed no 503 and no 5xx in the matching windows (e.g. 04:03-04:43 UTC: 103 x 200, 20 x 304, 3 x 307; 15:09-15:24 UTC: 48 x 200, 18 x 304, no 503). Nothing visible to the user, and no console error. Treated as a reporting artefact of the tool.

AC16, ACCOUNTS CREATED (D-51)
- chris@example.com: display name chris, avatar avatar-5, created 2026-09-14 04:39:57 UTC by the operator. Last sign-in 15:21:52 UTC. It is the only row in auth.users.
Attempted, not created: nobody-01@example.com (login attempt only, not a sign-up).
No email was sent (confirmation_sent_at null; no password-reset request made).

TO FIX
Dev Team: defects 1, 2 and 3 (functional). Defects 4, 5 and 6 are visual against frames 1.00, 3.00 and 8.14; Master Controller may decide they are in scope for this sprint or record deferrals. QA1 audit, then Pipeman reship.
